definitions.explanation: A medical condition that causes an adverse immune response to certain substances.
Figuratively, an intense dislike or negative reaction to something.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{物|もの}のアレルギーはありますか。
examples.english: Do you have any food allergies?

examples.japanese: {花粉|かふん}アレルギーで{春|はる}は{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: Spring is tough because of my pollen allergy.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{卵|たまご}アレルギーなので、{学校|がっこう}の{給食|きゅうしょく}では{別|べつ}のメニューを{用意|ようい}してもらっている。
examples.english: My daughter has an egg allergy, so the school prepares a separate menu for her at lunch.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{数学|すうがく}にアレルギーがある。
examples.english: He has an aversion to math.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}の{話題|わだい}にアレルギーを{示|しめ}す{人|ひと}は{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: Quite a few people show an aversion to political topics.

examples.japanese: ITにアレルギーがあった{父|ちち}も、スマートフォンを{使|つか}い{始|はじ}めてからは{便利|べんり}さに{気|き}づいたようだ。
examples.english: My father, who used to have an aversion to IT, seems to have realized how convenient it is since he started using a smartphone.

notes:
アレルギー is a loanword from German "Allergie."

COMMON TYPES OF ALLERGIES:
- {花粉|かふん}アレルギー - pollen allergy (hay fever)
- {食物|しょくもつ}アレルギー - food allergy
- {金属|きんぞく}アレルギー - metal allergy
- {薬物|やくぶつ}アレルギー - drug allergy
- ハウスダストアレルギー - dust allergy

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アレルギーがある - to have an allergy
- アレルギー{反応|はんのう} - allergic reaction
- アレルギー{症状|しょうじょう} - allergy symptoms
- アレルギー{体質|たいしつ} - allergic constitution

FIGURATIVE USE:
アレルギーがある can be used figuratively to mean having a strong dislike or aversion to something.
